name: TimelineRule
description: A rule that draws itself through 2-6 dated points; each node lights and its date and text arrive at their own time. Vertical (text right of the rule) or horizontal (dates above, text below). Fitted to the clip box.

when.description: the date or step, e.g. Day 100, 2024, Q3

text.description: what happened; long ones wrap to two lines

tone.description: this node's colour: theme token or CSS

at.description: Time this point lights: "line:3" or seconds from the clip start. Default: points spread over the first 60% of the clip

highlight.description: index of the point to stress (bigger node, coloured text)

at.description: Time the rule starts drawing: "line:2" or seconds from the clip start. Default: the clip start

color.description: lit node colour: theme token or CSS

ground.description: what it sits on; sets text and rule colours

points.text: Wins a laptop in the draw
